title: Partnership Standards & Disclosure Policy

blocks.text: Nina Caldwell Media — Partnership Standards & Disclosure Policy
Last reviewed: February 20, 2026. This document governs all brand partnerships, sponsored trips, gifted products, and paid collaborations entered into by Nina Caldwell Media LLC.
Core Disclosure Rule (Non-Negotiable)

ALL sponsored, gifted, or compensated content — regardless of platform, format, or brand request — must include explicit disclosure language. This includes but is not limited to: #ad, #sponsored, #gifted, or equivalent plain-language disclosure ('This post is sponsored by...', 'I was hosted by...'). This rule applies to Instagram posts, Reels, Stories, newsletter issues, blog posts, YouTube videos, and any other published format.
Class I Violations — Automatic Decline
Any contract clause requiring omission of #ad, #sponsored, or equivalent disclosure language.
Any brand request to present paid/gifted content as purely organic or editorial without disclosure.
Any agreement that includes a clawback clause triggered by disclosure compliance (i.e., penalizes Nina for following FTC/ASA guidelines).
Class II Concerns — Negotiate or Decline
Exclusivity clauses exceeding 30 days for competing destinations.
Pre-approval rights that require brand sign-off more than 48 hours before publication.
Messaging exclusivity that restricts Nina's editorial voice or requires brand-scripted copy.
Rationale

Audience trust is the foundation of Nina Caldwell Media's value to both readers and brand partners. Non-disclosure clauses violate FTC guidelines, undermine reader trust, and expose Nina to legal liability. No partnership fee justifies this risk. Partners who cannot accommodate standard disclosure are not aligned with Nina Caldwell Media's editorial values.
Response Protocol for Non-Compliant Inquiries

1. Do not draft or send an acceptance reply before policy review is complete.
2. Flag the inquiry in the Trip Pipeline database with status 'Policy Violation — Pending Decision'.
3. Present Nina with decline, counter-proposal, or defer options.
4. Log outcome in Trip Pipeline and add follow-up todo to maintain contact relationship.
